Notes to Consolidated Financial Results
i) These audited consolidated financial results which are published in accordance with Regulation 33 of the Securities Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ('Listing Regulations’) have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 14, 2026. These audited consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with recognition and measurement principles of Indian Accounting Standards ("Ind-AS") prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with the relevant rules issued thereunder and the other accounting principles generally accepted in India.
ii) The statutory auditors of the Parent Company have expressed an unmodified opinion in the audit report for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026.
iii) The figures for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 are the balancing figures between the audited figures in respect of the six months ended September 30, 2026 and the published unaudited year to date figures up to the first quarter of the current financial year.
iv) The Parent Company has three wholly owned subsidiaries Sonitron Bio Organics Private Limited, Dhampur International Pte. Limited and DBOL International Food & Beverages Trading FZE and one subsidiary DBION Private Limited (w.e.f. July 9, 2026) as on September 30, 2026.
v) "The Parent Company granted 3,57,881 stock options to the eligible employees of the Parent Company, which are convertibles into equal number of equity shares of the Parent Company of face value of Rs. 10/- each, at exercise price of Rs. 40/- each, through Trust route under the DBO Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025 in the previous year. During the previous quarter ended June 30, 2026, 6600 stock options are forfeited due to separation of an employee before vesting of options.
The Parent Company granted interest free loan to the DBO Employee Welfare Trust (Trust) for acquisition of shares through open market. The outstanding amount of loan as at September 30, 2026 is Rs. 7.15 Crores (including Rs. 0.50 Crore and Rs. 1.65 Crore granted during the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026 respectively). The Trust has acquired 7,74,383 shares (including 97,000 shares and 1,75,383 shares during the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026 respectively) from the market at an average price of Rs. 91.77 per share. Acquisition cost of shares held by the Trust is presented as reduction in ‘Other Equity’. Share based payment expense for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026 is Rs. 0.11 Crore and Rs. 0.21 Crore respectively (Rs. 0.07 Crore for quarter and six months ended September 30, 2025; Rs. 0.10 Crore for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 & Rs. 0.28 Crore for the year ended March 31, 2026). During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, one eligible employee has exercised option to acquire 13,541 shares at the exercised price. The Parent Company considers the Trust as an extension of the entity and accordingly, incorporated the financials of the Trust in the standalone financial statements of the Company."
vi) "During the previous quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Parent Company sold one of its sugar manufacturing undertaking comprising sugar and co-generation plant located at Meerganj, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, (“Meerganj Unit”) on slump sale basis for an aggregate consideration of Rs. 305.00 Crores which has been approved by the shareholders in the EGM held on May 18, 2026. The said Meerganj unit is transferred with effect from June 18, 2026 and full consideration has been received by the Parent Company resulting in the gain of Rs. 63.89 Crores on sale of the undertaking.
The operations of the said Meerganj unit of the Parent Company has been classified as the Discontinued Operations for all the periods presented in these consolidated financial results, in accordance with the applicable accounting standards."
The results of the business classified as discontinued operations in these consolidated financial results are as under:

The consolidated financial results, to the extent of Statement of Profit & Loss and its resulted impact on earnings per share and segment for the quarter and six month ended September 30, 2025 and for the year ended March 31, 2026, have been restated by excluding figures of Meerganj unit which have been included under discontinued operations for comparison purposes. Figures of the balance sheet as at the Six month ended September 30, 2026, exclude figures related to Meerganj unit and are not comparable with the corresponding figures of the previous reporting periods.
vii) During the previous year ended March 31, 2026 an action was taken by the Income Tax Department under section 132 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 at the business premises of the Parent Company on October 29, 2025. On receipt of notice under section 158BC of the Act, the Parent Company filed return for the block period from April 01, 2019 to December 27, 2025. Without prejudice to its rights and contentions, in order to mitigate legacy tax uncertainties and avoid/ minimize litigation, the Parent Company offered an ad hoc amount of Rs.4.30 Crores as additional income to tax in the tax return filed for the block period, including an amount of Rs. 0.53 Crores accounted as other income during the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The consequent tax liability of Rs. 2.68 crores has been included in the current tax provisions for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Parent Company has not received any orders/demand notices till date. The Management is of the view that there would not be any material adverse impact on the financial position of the Parent Company and hence no material adjustments are required to be made in the financial statements of the Parent Company.
viii) The Board of Directors of the Parent Company at its meeting held on November 14, 2026 approved buy back of shares for an amount upto Rs. 50 Crores, with maximum buy back price per share of Rs.200, subject to the approval of shareholders.
ix) Sugar being a seasonal industry, the performance of the quarter may not be representative of the annual performance of the Group.
x) Figures for the previous corresponding periods have been regrouped, wherever considered necessary.
xi) "The audited standalone financial results are available on the website of the Company (www.Dhampur.com).
